# Rust

This mod adds Rust to code-server and openvscode-server.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-rust
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-rust|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

In code-server or openvscode-server docker arguments, set an environment variable DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-rust

By default, the mod will install the latest stable version of Rust.  If you'd like to install a different version, you can specify the version as a tag, from a list of published tags: https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/mods/tags?page=1&name=code-server-rust

Supported  architectures:
- [x] linux/amd64
- [x] linux/aarch64

Supported docker base images:
- [x] ubuntu:jammy

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-rust/
